dimensions.assessment: Directly affects SBA headquarters employees whose work locations and telework policies would change.
dimensions.evidence: change the permanent duty station of not less than 30 percent of the headquarters employees of the Administration

dimensions.assessment: Requires relocations, changes to local pay scales, elimination of full-time telework for affected staff, and major office space reductions.
dimensions.evidence: reduce the amount of office space for the headquarters of the Administration by not less than 30 percent

dimensions.assessment: Requires the Administrator to determine and explain in a report that the requirements will reduce federal costs.
dimensions.evidence: if the Administrator determines that implementing the requirements under paragraphs (1) and (2) of this subsection will reduce the cost to the Federal Government

dimensions.assessment: Imposes agency-wide operational, structural, and reporting requirements specifically on the Small Business Administration.
dimensions.evidence: To require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to relocate 30 percent of the employees assigned to headquarters

dimensions.assessment: One-time implementation mandates for relocation and office downsizing, alongside ongoing annual budget reporting requirements.

missing_information: Exact count of SBA headquarters personnel
Specific financial cost estimates or savings totals
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Small Business Administration to relocate at least 30 percent of headquarters employees outside the Washington metropolitan area and reduce headquarters office space by at least 30 percent, subject to a cost-reduction determination.
